en.name: Spring roll wrappers
en.summary: These are the paper-thin wheat sheets used for fried spring rolls and 潤餅 — a fresh dough product, sold frozen because the sheets stale within hours at room temperature. Frozen they keep 2 months at −18 °C (0 °F); once thawed, use them within 1–2 days. Rice-paper wrappers are a different, fully dried product.
en.pantry: Spring roll wrappers are not a cupboard item. They are thin sheets of fresh wheat dough with a high surface area and no preservation beyond the cold, and left out they dry, crack and become unusable within hours — long before there is any question of safety, the pack is simply ruined. Keep them frozen until the day you need them, and once thawed treat them as a refrigerated fresh dough.
en.fridge: There is no separate unopened fridge figure here: the wrappers come frozen, and the fridge is where you thaw them and where they live for their 1–2 days afterwards. Thaw the sealed pack in the fridge, not on the counter, so the sheets come up to temperature evenly without sweating. Once the pack is opened, keep the stack under a damp cloth or a sheet of film while you work, because the exposed top sheet dries within minutes, and keep the remainder sealed and flat at the back of the fridge.
en.freezer: They keep 2 months at −18 °C (0 °F) in the sealed pack. Keep the block flat and sealed; freezer burn shows up as brittle, opaque patches that tear the moment you try to roll. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the two months are a quality limit borrowed from fresh pasta. Do not refreeze thawed sheets — they take up water on thawing and a second freeze turns them to paste.
en.thawing: Thaw the sealed pack overnight in the fridge, never on the counter and never in the microwave. Peel the sheets apart only when they are fully thawed — separating half-frozen sheets tears every one of them.
spoilage: Brittle, opaque or dried patches on the sheets, which tear as you roll.
A sour or fermented smell when the pack is opened.
Sheets fused into a solid block that will not separate, usually a sign of thawing and refreezing.
Any mould spot, or a slimy, tacky feel to the dough.
tips: Thaw only the pack you will use; the rest stays frozen.
Keep the stack covered with a damp cloth while you roll.
Peel from the corner of a fully thawed stack, one sheet at a time.
Do not confuse them with rice paper, which is dried and keeps in the cupboard for months.

faq.q: How long do spring roll wrappers keep?
faq.a: 2 months frozen at −18 °C (0 °F), and 1–2 days in the fridge once thawed.

faq.q: Can you refreeze thawed spring roll wrappers?
faq.a: No. They take up moisture on thawing, and a second freeze turns the sheets to paste.

faq.q: Are rice paper wrappers stored the same way?
faq.a: No. Rice paper is fully dried and keeps for months in a cupboard. These wheat sheets are a fresh dough that needs the freezer.

zh.name: 春捲皮
zh.summary: 這是炸春捲和潤餅用的薄如紙的小麥麵皮——一種新鮮麵團製品，之所以冷凍販售，是因為那種薄度在室溫下幾個小時就乾掉了。冷凍 −18 °C 下可放 2 個月；解凍後 1～2 天內用完。越南米紙則是完全不同的、徹底乾燥的產品。
zh.pantry: 春捲皮不是櫥櫃食品。它是表面積極大的新鮮小麥麵皮，除了低溫之外沒有任何保存手段；放在外面幾個小時就會乾裂、無法使用——還輪不到談安全，那包皮就已經報廢了。請一直冷凍到要用的那天，解凍後就當成冷藏的新鮮麵團處理。
zh.fridge: 這裡沒有另外給未開封的冷藏數字：這種皮是冷凍販售的，冰箱是你用來解凍、以及解凍後那 1～2 天存放的地方。請把整包密封放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面，讓每張皮均勻回溫又不出汗。拆封後，操作時請用濕布或保鮮膜蓋住整疊，因為最上面那張幾分鐘就會乾掉；沒用到的部分要密封、平放在冰箱內側。
zh.freezer: 維持密封包裝在 −18 °C 下可放 2 個月。整塊平放並保持密封；凍傷會表現為脆而不透明的斑塊，一捲就破。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的；這兩個月是借自生鮮義大利麵的品質期限。解凍過的皮不要再冷凍——它在解凍時吸了水，再凍一次就會變成糊。
zh.thawing: 整包密封冷藏隔夜解凍，不要放室溫，也不要微波。等完全解凍再一張張撕開——半凍狀態硬撕，每一張都會破。
spoilage: 皮上出現脆而不透明的乾斑，一捲就破。
拆封時聞到酸味或發酵味。
整疊黏成一塊怎麼也撕不開，通常代表曾經解凍又回凍。
出現任何霉點，或麵皮摸起來黏滑。
tips: 只解凍你要用的那一包，其餘維持冷凍。
操作時用濕布蓋著整疊。
完全解凍後從角落一張一張撕。
不要和越南米紙搞混，米紙是乾貨，放櫥櫃可以放好幾個月。

faq.a: −18 °C 冷凍 2 個月；解凍後冷藏 1～2 天。

faq.q: 解凍後的春捲皮可以再冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 不行。它在解凍時吸了水，再凍一次會變成糊狀。

faq.q: 越南米紙也是這樣保存嗎？
faq.a: 不是。米紙是完全乾燥的產品，放櫥櫃可以放好幾個月；春捲皮是需要冷凍的新鮮麵皮。
